t: Introducing Avid Reader Press, A New Imprint from Simon & Schuster – News and Corporate Information about Simon & Schuster
s: October 29, 2018 - The new imprint will be led by Jofie Ferrari-Adler, Vice President and Publisher, and Ben Loehnen, Vice President and Editor in Chief, who will leave their current editorial positions in the Simon & Schuster trade imprint. The imprint, which takes its name and inspiration from the spirit evoked in former Simon & Schuster editor in chief Robert Gottlieb’s memoir Avid Reader, will publish its first books in late 2019 or early 2020.
